$why: Run through .bench/design-check.sh, which starts a fresh Bench on its own data folder with the fake SDK, seeds it (.bench/design-check.seed.mjs) and fills the {project}/{task}/{taskSession}/{session}/{emptyProject} ids in these routes. grid 4 is Design.md's Space decision. bodyPx 11 is Design.md's Type decision: --text-xs is the smallest step of the scale and is deliberate chrome (counts, badges), so 11 is the floor this project sets itself; the defects it catches are the off-scale 10px/12px literals that belong to no step. Both are the project's own recorded numbers, not exemptions for this app.
